lessons.note: gh CLI respects GH_TOKEN env var; set it from MAGO_GH_TOKEN in exec.Command by appending to os.Environ() before cmd.Output() — do NOT use cmd.Env = []string{} or you drop all inherited env. Auth-error detection needs to cover 401/403/bad-credentials/must-log-in/not-logged-in patterns (case-insensitive) to be robust across gh CLI versions.
